name: Eleos Health

short_description: Eleos Health is the System of Action for community-based behavioral health care, combining AI-powered documentation, eligibility verification, and clinical insights to automate administrative work...
long_description: Eleos Health positions itself as the System of Action for community-based behavioral health care, going beyond simple AI scribing to execute work in the moment. Powered by its purpose-built Polaris AI platform, Eleos transforms clinical and operational signals into real-time action, automating repetitive administrative work including verifying eligibility, guiding documentation, and ensuring compliance. The platform offers a portfolio of products including Scribe, Quick Note, Outreach, and Verify designed specifically for the behavioral health sector. Eleos has scientifically proven results showing 70%+ reduction in documentation time, 2x boost in client engagement, and 3-4x improvement in symptom reduction. Key 2025 enhancements include universal one-on-one session support from psychiatry to case management, 150+ language support, and offline documentation for rural and field-based care. Eleos integrates with major EHRs including AdvancedMD, Kipu, SmartCare, and Welligent. The company raised $60M Series C in January 2025, bringing total funding to over $120M.

pricing.notes: Eleos is sold through demos and custom contracts rather than transparent pricing. The price tag can cause initial sticker shock, so organizations typically evaluate ROI through time saved, quality of notes, client care experience, clinician satisfaction, and staff retention.

faqs.a: Eleos Health is the System of Action for community-based behavioral health care. Powered by its Polaris AI platform, it goes beyond AI scribing to automate eligibility verification, documentation guidance, and compliance while improving client outcomes with proven 3-4x symptom reduction.

faqs.q: How much does Eleos Health cost?
faqs.a: Eleos Health is sold through custom enterprise contracts. Pricing is not publicly disclosed. Organizations typically evaluate ROI through time saved, note quality, and staff retention improvements.
Yes, Eleos introduced mobile offline documentation in 2025 for providers working in rural and field-based care settings. All note content automatically syncs to the EHR when connectivity is restored.
Eleos Documentation supports over 150 languages, making it suitable for behavioral health organizations serving diverse populations.

faqs.q: What EHRs does Eleos integrate with?
faqs.a: Eleos integrates with major behavioral health EHRs including AdvancedMD, Kipu, SmartCare, Welligent, EchoVantage, Exym, and eHana. The browser extension approach enables easier implementation without extensive EHR customization.
